meta.title: Sniffy — Open-source cross-platform proxy & debugger
meta.description: Open-source network proxy for HTTP/HTTPS, WebSocket, gRPC, and SSE traffic with rewrite rules, breakpoints, and JavaScript plugins.
meta.ogDescription: Inspect HTTP/HTTPS, WebSocket, gRPC, and SSE traffic with rules, breakpoints, and JS plugins. Apache 2.0.
meta.ogImageAlt: Sniffy — Open-source proxy & traffic debugger, showing the workbench request list and JSON details

a11y.copyFailed: This browser blocked clipboard access. Select the code and copy it manually.

description: Inspect HTTP/HTTPS, WebSocket, gRPC, and SSE traffic.
Rewrite responses with rules, pause at breakpoints, replay calls, or script traffic in JS.
hero.allDownloadsSub: Standalone binaries, Linux DEB & previous versions
hero.footnote: Click around the preview above — pick a request, filter by type, or toggle themes. Grab the desktop app to capture local and mobile traffic.

features.title: What it does
features.description: Inspect, edit, replay, and script traffic — all in one window.

capture.title: Multi-protocol capture
capture.text: View HTTP/HTTPS, WebSocket frames, gRPC, and SSE streams in one list, with JSON tree, Raw, and Hex views plus process names.

rules.title: Rewrite & mock rules
rules.text: Match by host, path, or method to point production APIs at localhost, tweak headers, block calls, or return mock JSON.

breakpoints.title: Live breakpoints
breakpoints.text: Hold a request before it goes out — or a response before it comes back — tweak the status, headers, or body, then let it through.

plugins.title: JavaScript plugins
plugins.text: When rules aren't flexible enough, drop in a few lines of JS right inside the app for signing, dynamic mocks, or shared state. Saves take effect right away.

compose.title: Replay & compose
compose.text: Tweak and resend any captured request, or build one from scratch. Imports and copies cURL commands out of the box.

har.title: Large bodies & HAR export
har.text: Big media or file responses spill to disk cache so long sessions stay light on RAM. Import or export HAR files and strip cookies or auth headers before sharing.

demos.title: A few everyday workflows
demos.description: Pick a tab on the left to see SSE streaming, breakpoints, and mock rules in action.

sse.title: Watch LLM SSE streams live
sse.summary: Open a chat completion call and watch chunks arrive event by event instead of waiting for the full response.
sse.alt: Sniffy displays the SSE events from a streaming chat completion as they arrive

breakpoint.title: Hold, edit, and resume a request
breakpoint.summary: Catch a checkout call before it leaves, switch shipping to express, resume, and check the updated quote right away.
breakpoint.alt: Sniffy pauses a checkout request, edits the shipping method, and resumes to show the updated quote

mock.title: Return mock JSON with a rule
mock.summary: Add a mock rule on an inventory endpoint to return an out-of-stock payload on the spot — no need to touch staging.
mock.alt: Sniffy creates a mock inventory rule and displays the matching JSON response

plugins.title: Script traffic with a few lines of JS
plugins.description: For request signing, dynamic responses, or anything rules can't cover, hook into requests, responses, or WebSocket frames with JavaScript. Hit Run below to try them.
plugins.ready: Hit Run example to see the script output.
plugins.pending: Tweak the input and run again to see what changes.
plugins.failed: Web Crypto is unavailable here. Open over localhost or HTTPS to run the example.
plugins.footnote: Built-in crypto, JSON, headers, key-value store, and plugin settings — reloads automatically on save

signing.label: Request signing
signing.note: Change the order amount and hit Run — it recomputes the SHA-256 hash and HMAC signature into the headers.

mock.label: Simulate errors
mock.note: Flip between 200, 401, and 503 to check how your UI handles expired sessions or outages.

token.label: Pass tokens along
token.note: Grab the token from a login response into store, then attach it automatically on later requests.

token.title: Carry session tokens across requests
token.done: Saved token and injected Authorization header.

editions.title: Desktop app and headless CLI
editions.description: Use the desktop app on your laptop, or drop the headless binary onto a Linux box or CI runner. Rules and plugins work the same in both.

desktop.title: Desktop app
desktop.text: A 10–15 MB installer that launches quickly. Handy for daily API checks and mobile debugging.
points: One-click system proxy toggle and guided HTTPS certificate setup
Light and dark themes with several color palettes
Installers and standalone binaries for macOS, Windows, and Linux

matrix.macos: DMG Installer / Standalone · Apple Silicon & Intel

headless.title: Headless server
headless.text: Single-binary CLI for Linux, macOS, and Windows (x64 & ARM64) — run it on a server or CI runner and drive it over REST and WebSocket.
points: Token authentication on by default for all management endpoints
HTTPS support with safe defaults for remote access
Query sessions, update rules, and stream live events over the API
